changes: Full project restructure per the new layout spec. Structure: one folder per module - kernel/{arch/x86_64,core,mem,lib,crypto,ota,generated}, drivers/{block,nic,snd,usb,input,display,pci}, fs/, net/, shell/, l1/, libs/ (ld.so), boot/. File names follow [category]_[specific] (driver_block_ahci.c, fs_vfs.c, net_core.c). 10113 interface renames to the same convention (usb_->driver_usb_, vfs_->fs_vfs_, cmd_->shell_cmd_, bn_->crypto_bn_, update_->ota_update_); standard names restored (memcpy/strlen), kmalloc kept. Shell command surface unchanged: 170 commands, help 3 modes. Build 0 errors/0 warnings; BIOS+UEFI dual boot verified. Regression green: WP-09 core suites, WP-10a storage on four real disks (ata_dma 3/3, ahci 2/2, nvme 3/3, virtio 2/2, partition 2/2, fs_mount 4/4), WP-10b e1000e TX/RX, WP-10c HDA play, WP-10u update_pkg 12/12 + ab_partition 7/7, WP-10d USB 4 devices.
